description.value: A scenic lakeside campground tucked in the Cascade Mountains near Tulameen, best known for lake trout fishing and old-fashioned camping with abundant wildlife; access roads are narrow and winding with logging truck traffic, and the gate closes for winter.

address.value: 33 km northwest of Princeton off Hwy 5A, near Tulameen, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a BC Parks frontcountry campground in the Cascade Mountain Range, 33 km northwest of Princeton off Hwy 5A. OSM tags provide supplementary data: drinking_water=yes, toilets=yes, shower=no, reservation=yes, power_supply=no, internet_access=no. The website confirms reservations are available through the BC Parks frontcountry camping system. Potable water is tagged in OSM and consistent with a frontcountry BC Parks campground but not explicitly stated on the park page. No mention of hiker/biker sites, food storage, showers, laundry, or other cyclist-specific amenities on the website.
concerns: OSM phone (+1-250-548-0076) and email (info@campokanagan.com) belong to the contracted operator Kaloya Contracting Ltd., not BC Parks directly; these may change if the operating contract changes.
No formal street address exists; location is described by highway directions only.
Website mentions grizzly bears in the area but no mention of bear-proof food storage or lockers at the campground.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate BC Parks frontcountry campground on Hwy 5A between Princeton and Merritt, a plausible touring cyclist route through the Okanagan and Thompson regions. Vehicle-accessible with potable water and reservations available.
